title: U-NeXt: General-purpose event detection for neonatal EEG
abstract: arXiv:2610.32811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We developed U-NeXt, a general framework for neonatal electroencephalography (EEG) event detection based on semantic segmentation. Its convolutional encoder-decoder directly segments individual channels using long input segments to preserve temporal context. A shared architecture and training framework were developed using low-voltage interval, artefact, and seizure datasets containing 51, 98, and 278 neonates, respectively, comprising over 11,000 hours of EEG and 82,000 annotated events. Performance was compared with task-specific ConvNeXt classifiers. For seizure detection, we also evaluated U-NeXt+, trained on an expanded dataset. Both U-NeXt variants and the ConvNeXt baseline were evaluated on two independent held-out seizure datasets, Helsinki and Cork, comprising 130 neonates, with recordings annotated by three experts. U-NeXt improved detection across all three event types, with particular gains in sensitivity for short events. U-

translated_title: U-NeXt：面向新生儿脑电图的通用事件检测框架
translated_abstract: 我们开发了U-NeXt，这是一个基于语义分割的新生儿脑电图（EEG）事件检测通用框架。其卷积编码器-解码器结构直接对单个通道进行分割，并使用长输入片段以保留时间上下文。我们基于低电压区间、伪迹和癫痫发作三个数据集（分别包含51名、98名和278名新生儿）构建了共享的架构与训练框架，共涵盖超过11,000小时的脑电数据和82,000个标注事件。我们将该框架与任务特定的ConvNeXt分类器进行了性能比较。针对癫痫发作检测，我们还评估了在扩充数据集上训练的U-NeXt+。两个U-NeXt变体与ConvNeXt基线模型均在两个独立的留出癫痫发作数据集（Helsinki和Cork，共130名新生儿）上进行评估，其记录由三位专家标注。U-NeXt在所有三种事件类型的检测中均有所提升，在短事件检测的敏感性方面提升尤为显著。
tldr: 提出了U-NeXt——一个基于语义分割的新生儿脑电通用事件检测框架，通过统一的卷积编码器-解码器架构对低电压区间、伪迹和癫痫发作三类事件实现了优于任务特定模型的检测性能，尤其在短事件检测的敏感性上有显著提升。
en_tdlr: We propose U-NeXt, a general-purpose semantic segmentation framework for neonatal EEG event detection that outperforms task-specific ConvNeXt classifiers across low-voltage interval, artefact, and seizure detection, with particularly improved sensitivity for short events.
